entries.german:
Fulda wider v. Rosenbach wegen eines Centkostenbeitrags wegen der zu Bieberstein im Arrest gesessenen und endlich zu Fulda justifizierten Delinquenten

Laufzeit: 1741
entries.english:
Fulda against von Rosenbach concerning a contribution toward the costs of the cent court for the offenders who had been held under arrest at Bieberstein and were eventually executed at Fulda.

Term: 1741
